encoding.canonical_payload: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, allow_nan=False; SHA-256
encoding.received_file: SHA-256 of retained file bytes; distinct from canonical payload digest
encoding.identity: canonical_id is an operator-reviewed issuer identity; every symbol/source alias must be attributable to retained lineage evidence

policy.splits: reject any reported split in full open-left five-year context
policy.classification: reviewed operating_common on supported US exchange; vendor EQUITY is insufficient

config.fixed: profile training-five-year-v1; reviewer_id nonempty assigned human; seeds integers excluding bool; id_salt nonempty; frozen policy above applies, no HTTP override
config.detector_manifest: version, parameter_hash, source_file_sha256 must equal locally trusted v1; context_sessions=180 may be stamped in derived reference
config.exposure: complete training-exposure-v1 ledger described below; builder requires it, never defaults to empty

source.bars: canonical ordered unique ISO dates and finite positive OHLC/valid relationships/nonnegative volume; full retained input, no mutation
source.cutoffs: explicit ordered unique completed-session dates present in bars; reject/ignore no future bars in selected window; sampler records actual eligible frames
source.aliases: includes source_id and symbol; alias_evidence has reviewed=true and nonempty receipt_sha256 plus provenance; unknown lineage excludes source
source.classification: reviewed=true, security_type=operating_common, exchange=NASDAQ|NYSE|NYSE_AMERICAN|NYSE_ARCA|CBOE_BZX, evidence_sha256 and provenance; only universe classification, not fundamental buy clearance
source.provenance: source_sha256 is retained raw received-file digest; fetched_at offset timestamp; valid timezone; explicit split_dates; adapter must reparse raw bytes and compare full source instead of trusting embedded self-declared hashes

catalog.exposure: must equal current history exposure on allocation; complete conservative bootstrap required

exposure.complete: strict boolean; false or missing provenance produces needs_data, not empty ledger
exposure.evidence: list of {path, received_sha256}; retained legacy artifacts and reviewed identity receipts; no fabricated pre-reveal prefix commitment
exposure.aliases: mapping alias string -> canonical_id; sources must agree
exposure.targets: list of {canonical_id,start,end,case_fingerprint,provenance}; all historically human-labeled target20 intervals including revisions and aliases; overlap inclusive excludes allocation
exposure.views: list of {canonical_id,start,end,provenance}; all historically displayed full contexts. Broader-view overlap allowed development only, recorded in cases
exposure.reservations: list of {canonical_id,start,end,active,provenance}; active future-validation canonical source OR interval overlap denied; historical exposed releases keep prior roles and are not active future reservations
exposure.missing: unknown queue/alias/target/view provenance blocks affected sources or complete ledger; no guessed empty history

queue.cards: anonymous normalized 180-session detail plus five-year overview; offsets only, no identity/dates/predictions
queue.sealed: config, full source receipts/input fingerprints, cases, detector_manifest, reference, exclusions, eligible frame sizes and sampling memberships; all bound before labels
queue.cases: canonical identity, source/cutoff/full window/input180 hashes, target dates, immutable predictions from last180 only and target20, memberships random/enriched, exposure overlap; exact raw bars for independent reproduction
queue.reference: training-round-reference-v1 commitment: protocol, detector_manifest, prediction_hash, inputs_hash, context_sessions=180, visual_context_years=5; commitment_hash excludes itself, no queue_hash circularity
queue.queue_hash: canonical hash of entire queue excluding queue_hash; token exactly equals this hash

labels.entries: append-only canonical server-derived history; sole assigned human; revision and supersedes_revision plus view_protocol, view_token, overview_hash, reference_hash, detector_version/input stamps; never caller-authoritative generated stamps
labels.entry: case_id, reviewer_id, decision, rationale, events, expected_revision, revise, view_token; events exact {kind, completion_offset}; kinds inverse_head_shoulders|cup_handle|head_shoulders_top; offsets -19..0 integers; completed iff nonempty events, none/uncertain/invalid empty; rationale max1000
labels.retry: identical normalized latest label idempotent, preserving original acknowledged history; changed label requires explicit revise=true and current expected_revision; stale/missing token always fails first
labels.snapshot: complete sole-human history immutable by canonical hash; later explicit revisions seal new superseding development snapshot; original snapshot/report remains retained

history.rounds: ordered list {round_id,status,queue,labels,snapshots}; status derived ready -> labeling -> complete, at most one ready/labeling; immutable previous queues/snapshots; labels append only
history.requests: mapping request_id -> {payload_hash,round_id,outcome}; idempotency retained in authoritative transaction, not materialized cache
history.transition: pure output includes status, round_id/round if present, history, exclusions; no caller input mutation; needs_data is non-round outcome; invalid coherent commitments raise ValueError

request.config: config object without exposure permitted for request; current catalog/history exposure injected by transition; source/catalog/exposure fingerprints bound to allocated round
request.conflict: same request_id changed request payload -> ValueError before any mutation; identical retry reproduces/resumes recorded outcome; a new id with active round resumes that round without extra allocation

original_release.validation: rebuild exact release via freeze_evaluation(parent_queue,release.calibration_labels) against trusted frozen executables; assisted queue parent/context hashes and 180 raw tails must reconcile; receipt from retained file with canonical pass and queue digests, revealed_at_utc offset timestamp; canonical pass change cannot satisfy original receipt
original_release.chronology: valid receipt binds locked snapshot before identity delivery; timing unknown if no valid receipt or conflicting anchors; do not forge an earlier prefix. Missing receipt null may yield reveal_timing_unknown development-only; conflicting present receipt fails

training_round.commitment: exact sealed queue.reference; independent trusted source/version/commit-before-display ownership enforced by adapter; pure seam reproduces input/prediction commitments and sole-human stamped history
training_round.chronology: development round, no independence assertion; optional prior snapshot hash attributes revisions, never substitutes original receipt

diagnostic.status: complete only after all sole-human cases reviewed; pending has coverage and no comparison/inventory
diagnostic.by_stratum: same per-kind fields separately random/enriched; overlap counted once overall and once per applicable stratum
diagnostic.inventory: private case-level matched/unmatched observations/predictions, uncertain/invalid, context-policy ambiguity or demonstrated requirement with explicit reproducible requirement evidence. Disagreement and prose alone never establish defect
diagnostic.report_hash: canonical output excluding report_hash; no timestamps/non-deterministic values

http.GET /api/training: whitelisted assigned-user hub, own progress/order/history; incomplete no predictions/identities/receipts/diagnostics; completed personal diagnostics allowed
http.GET /api/training/card: round_id and case_id fixed lookups; own_label, card, overview, view_token
http.POST /api/training/round: {request_id}; server freezes assigned config; cannot choose file/module/threshold; active round resumes
http.POST /api/training/label: {round_id, case_id, reviewer_id, decision, rationale, events, expected_revision, revise, view_token}; server identity strict; token checked against immutable durable queue before any recovery write
http.guards: localhost host/origin, bounded JSON <=16KiB, lock; read-only old routes unchanged
http.persistence: single authoritative append/fsync transaction binds request, round, queue, exposure, labels and completed snapshot before ack; materialized views atomic/replaceable; partial unacked tails archived only after valid action. Every replay revalidates trusted registry/source/legacy evidence; missing evidence fails closed
http.paths: operator --training-dir only; no HTTP path selection; synthetic QA only disposable isolated store; production private/training; frozen legacy and paper never mutated

analyze_training_pass.outputs: diagnostic object; private immutable replay inputs; no filesystem writes/network
analyze_training_pass.bindings: queue, complete single human history, reference variant, actual executable manifest/context180, canonical snapshot and receipt, predictions reproduced
analyze_training_pass.failures: ValueError corrupt/incomplete/changed/conflicting evidence; missing chronology explicitly timing_unknown as above

build_review_queue.outputs: queue object; empty order with admission exclusions when no candidates, to be exposed by request as needs_data
build_review_queue.bindings: strict training-only profile/one human; trusted180 executable/version/parameters; complete source/classification/alias/exposure receipts; deterministic config/seed/input/window/cutoff/reference hashes
build_review_queue.failures: ValueError malformed config/coherent commitments; invalid/missing candidate provenance admission exclusion; never shorten five years

record_review_label.outputs: new labels history with derived version/view/input stamps; identical retry returns same history
record_review_label.bindings: sole human, exact view_token before other action, normalized event/revision controls; immutable input
record_review_label.failures: ValueError missing/stale token, unknown case/reviewer, malformed events, conflicting revisions or history

summarize_review.outputs: status ready|labeling|complete, progress, own_labels; complete adds canonical completed_pass/pass_hash plus personal diagnostic from training reference; pending diagnostic null
summarize_review.bindings: single human, complete snapshots separately retained by adapter; no relaxed legacy consensus
summarize_review.failures: ValueError corrupt queue/history/reference; no answers in incomplete summaries

request_training_round.outputs: transition with history, status created|resumed|needs_data, round_id/round where present, exclusions
request_training_round.bindings: one active round, immutable previous records, canonical aliases/target exclusion/reservations, request conflict/idempotency and commitment before display
request_training_round.failures: ValueError conflict or malformed/coherently forged durable history; incomplete catalog/exposure returns needs_data without round allocation

cannot satisfy original receipt; retain original report; separate new development snapshot
needs_data or affected-source exclusion, never empty exposure assumption
